label: pjm 29 coopt
definition: Structure test: in-LP energy+reserve co-optimization replacing pjm_28's reduced-form reserve withholding + post-solve ORDC overlay. Per-zone reserve variable shares thermal headroom with energy (P+R<=cap); reserve balance at the measured PJM Primary Reserve requirement (backcast; 1.5x-MSSC formula for forecast) priced by the published two-step ORDC curve, so the reserve clearing price is the balance dual and lifts the energy LMP. FINDING: LMP essentially unchanged vs pjm_28 (2023 -1.1%, 2024 -7.7%, 2025 -16.8%; 2025 coal-tot +5.1% still the one fail) because PJM's ~3.4 GW reserve requirement is small vs abundant fleet headroom, so the reserve price is ~0 in nearly all hours. The LMP under-run is therefore NOT reserve opportunity cost (correcting the pjm_28 hypothesis); the co-opt is the structurally-faithful clearing mechanism (kept per claude.md #1, well-behaved -- does not over-lift the calibrated 2023) but neutral for PJM. Residual now points to the interchange gap (net under-export -24%/-46%) as the next structural lever.
